column1: # The environment matrix (M7-8, M7c-2): one row per line, tab-separated.
#   name    the row; results go to tests/results/envmatrix/<tag>/<name>/
#   kind    dynamic: SET GLOBAL on a long-lived pair of MX_IMAGE, restored after the row
#           init:    a fresh pair of MX_IMAGE with an extra cnf (settable only at initialization)
#           version: a fresh, unmutated pair of another image
#           group:   dbsgomysql's Group Replication cluster as the source, with a fresh
#                    destination; the unfinished-work guard tests only
#   setup   dynamic: the SQL, run on both servers ("-" for none), or on the destination only
#           when it starts with "dst:" (PKT-1); init: the cnf, relative to this directory;
#           version: the image; group: the image of dbsgomysql's Group Replication cluster
#           (group/README.md), whose primary is the source; only the unfinished-work guard
#   expect  pass, or refuse:CODE[|CODE...] (tests/envmatrix/judge): every failing test must
#           cite one of the codes, the M7-8 rule that a run is exact or refused by name

column3: SET GLOBAL character_set_server = latin1; SET GLOBAL collation_server = latin1_swedish_ci

column1: # max_allowed_packet_4m: MySQL 5.7's default. One batch's INSERT in
# max_allowed_packet_dst_4m: the destination's packet only (PKT-1). A value larger than
# it exists in the source, so the copy's one remaining packet failure, PacketError, is
# sql_select_limit_20: a global limit new sessions inherit. TestMySQLArchiveUnderAFiniteSelectLimit
# reads a 25-column table and an order's 30 lines through the CLI (beta audit A1).
# max_error_count_0: goarchive's pools raise a session at 0 to 1024, or refuse with
# MAX_ERROR_COUNT_CHECK (TestMySQLMaxErrorCount, which runs only on this row). The suites open
# goarchive's pools (database.OpenPool), so a root session is raised and runs, and a
# least-privilege account without SESSION_VARIABLES_ADMIN is refused at open by name, as the
# binary refuses it (M7c-F6). The runtime backstop is TestMySQLInsertDiagnosticsRetention's
# init_connect_set_names: a narrowing init_connect for accounts without CONNECTION_ADMIN; goarchive's
# SET NAMES runs after it and restores utf8mb4 (CHS-1, TestMySQLInitConnectCharset)

column3: SET GLOBAL wait_timeout = 10; SET GLOBAL interactive_timeout = 10
